NanoSVG, by Mikko Mononen
Upstream: https://github.com/memononen/nanosvg
Taken from: commit 239e102ec2c691f2902e20ace2ed36ee4a35cfe6 (2026-07-09)
Files: src/nanosvg.h, src/nanosvgrast.h and LICENSE.txt, verbatim apart from
the change below.

Changes:

1. nanosvg.h, nsvg__createGradient: in objectBoundingBox units (a gradient's
   default), a coordinate with no unit is a fraction of the shape's box, so
   x2="1" is its right edge and r="0.5" half of it. Upstream reads such a
   number as user-space pixels, which drew a gradient from x1="0" to x2="1"
   as its last colour. The new nsvg__bboxFraction turns those coordinates
   into the percentages they mean before they're converted. Each changed
   place is marked "svgio:".

2. nanosvg.h: NSVG_MAX_ATTR, the depth of nested groups the parser tracks,
   is defined only when the build hasn't defined it. Every level is a
   300-byte block held for the whole parse, so 128 levels cost about 41 KB
   for any file; svgio_nanosvg.c asks for 32.

src/svgio_nanosvg.c compiles both headers with the C library calls they make
pointed at svgio's own (the MicroPython heap for memory, and small number,
colour and sort routines that every port can link), by macros defined before
the headers are included.
